prerequisites: No prerequisites. Competencies taught in the modules Object-Oriented Programming, Algorithms and Data Structures, and Software Engineering are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: have an overview of possible procedures for software quality assurance and improvement.
know basic knowledge of the presented techniques.
know typical tools for quality assurance.
are able to apply scientific working methods in independently identifying, formulating, and solving problems.
are able to speak freely about scientific content, both in front of an audience and in a discussion.

syllabus_topics: Software quality criteria (correctness, robustness, changeability, reusability, user-friendliness)

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation of solutions to at least two exercise assignments

assessment_rules: To acquire credits, students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments and orally present the solution to at least two exercise assignments. The final examination is either an oral examination (individual) or a written examination. Grading is based on a scale of 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the B.Sc. Computer Science degree program.
